📊 Strategy Criteria

VCP (Volatility Contraction Pattern)

• Volume > 1M
• 6M Return ≥ 50%
• Close > SMA50
• Distance from High ≤ 25%

Qullamaggie Breakout

• Volume > 1M
• 6M Return ≥ 50%
• Close > SMA20
• Distance from High ≤ 15%

HTF (High Tight Flag)

• Volume > 1M
• 6M Return 50-150%
• ADR 3-15%
• Close > SMA50
• Distance from High ≤ 20%

RS (Relative Strength)

Stock's TradingView 6M return minus SPY's yfinance 6M return.
Positive = outperforming market by percentage points.

GS (Gamma Squeeze Candidate)

Short-dated CALL Vol/OI spike with near/OTM strike, estimated premium, and stock momentum context.
First Seen is scanner detection time; Last Trade is yfinance contract lastTradeDate. yfinance cannot confirm buy-at-ask, sweeps, BTO/STO, or whale intent — use UW/flow data to confirm.

Gamma Wall

Nearest major upper/lower high-gamma strike and current pin candidate from 30DTE option chains. Wall strength is 0-100 within each stock, where 100 is that stock's largest abs-GEX strike. Basis OI uses open interest; Basis VOL is an intraday volume-gamma fallback when yfinance returns zero OI. Zero gamma is a regime boundary, not a magnet. yfinance data is a proxy and does not reveal true dealer inventory.

Short Fuel

Short Float % and days-to-cover from yfinance. High fuel = Short Float ≥ 10% or DTC ≥ 3; Very High = Short Float ≥ 20% or DTC ≥ 5.
Data can be delayed/stale, so treat it as squeeze context, not a real-time covering signal.

Call/Float

Displayed gamma contract volume × 100 ÷ float shares. This explains how large the shown contract is relative to float; it is not an independent signal and is not delta-adjusted. ≥2% is notable, ≥5% high, ≥10% extreme.
